description: NAWA PR to PO witness. Execution is Skills on the generic MCP connector (sap + hikma). One approved PR per scheduled tick — the walker loop kind cannot nest budget/HITL. Budget reject writes without HITL; create_po and handle_rejection wait for the NAWA gate. task.format_dossier is the training python_recipe_v1 with a managed env (tabulate).

system.name: PR to PO
system.objective: List approved purchase requisitions, reject those over budget without a human, and package an in-budget PR for NAWA approval before posting a PO via SAP MCP.

note: Flow body is built by app.services.connectors.mcp.flow.pr_to_po_flow so seed and tests share one graph.
